observed_problem: The current Quality Bundle uses one universal list of eleven all-PASS rows for every edition and does not distinguish deterministic checks from ChatGPT semantic/visual review. This over-applies Long-form concerns to Weekly and encourages treating agent-authored editorial judgments as if they must be executable validators.
expected_behavior: Quality review must be Profile/Publication-aware and explicitly classify checks as DETERMINISTIC, AGENT_SEMANTIC or AGENT_VISUAL. Only deterministic checks require executable validator/result provenance. Agent semantic/visual checks are reasoned review records tied to the reviewed source/PDF revision. Inapplicable checks are absent rather than ceremonially passed.
actual_behavior: config/survey-production-v2.json and scripts/survey_quality_v2.py now derive applicable checks from Core + Research Profile + Publication Profile and distinguish DETERMINISTIC, AGENT_SEMANTIC and AGENT_VISUAL. Deterministic rows require result authority; agent rows require reasoned evidence and may not claim deterministic result authority.

provenance.human_review_reference: User premise correction and ChatGPT-first pre-approval re-audit, 2026-08-22

improvement_action: Implemented by WU-012F: profile-aware DETERMINISTIC/AGENT_SEMANTIC/AGENT_VISUAL review kinds with exact revision binding and no ceremonial inapplicable rows.
